responsibility: This file implements the AArch64 late RTL pass that inserts Branch Target Identification instructions when branch protection enables BTI. It walks the finalized control-flow and RTL instruction stream to place BTI C at function entries that may be reached by indirect calls and are not already protected by PACIASP/PACIBSP, and to place BTI J after labels that can be reached by indirect jumps, jump tables, nonlocal gotos, deleted-label preservation points, or setjmp return sites. The file’s responsibility is therefore the target-specific post-generation hardening step that materializes BTI landing pads in executable code, exposed through make_pass_insert_bti.
